text:
AcmeJane: Hey, we started seeing a big increase in embedding request latencies this morning. 99th pct went from ~180ms to >1.5s. Not sure if it's our client or your side.

Sam (Support): Hey @AcmeJane sorry to hear that. Can you paste a minimal repro + client config? Also which model/endpoint?

AcmeJane: Using embeddings v1 on embeddings.redwood.prod, 512-dim vectors. We call batch endpoint with max_batch_size=64 and rely on dynamic batching. Example request: ```python
payloads = [ {"text": s} for s in texts ]
client.embeddings.create(model="embed-512", input=payloads)
# we set max_batch_size=64 in our config
```

Sam (Support): Got it. Can you share a short window of request ids (IDs ok) and approximate QPS?

AcmeJane: QPS ~25 steady, spikes to 40 for a few minutes. Here are three request ids: r1_031, r1_032, r1_033. Latencies for those: 1.6s, 1.42s, 1.9s.

Sam (Support): Thanks. I'm seeing a pattern in our logs — queuing time before batching is high for those IDs. Tagging @Liz to check batching routing.

Liz H: pinged. I'm seeing an unusual fanout where many small requests are being held waiting to form full batches across shards. Dynamic batching decided to wait up to 200ms to fill batches, but combined with shard-handoff it adds extra latency.

Megan (Infra SRE): Adding context: we rolled a scheduler tweak last night that adjusted inter-shard batching thresholds to favor throughput on cold nodes. That can increase tail for single-tenant-ish workloads.

AcmeJane: Any mitigation we can do on our side quickly? Turning down max_batch_size? Turning off dynamic batching?

Sam (Support): Short-term options: reduce max_batch_size to 32 or 16 so your requests flush faster, or set prefer_latency=true on the call if you have that flag. We can also pin you to a lower-concurrency dedicated pool if needed.

Liz H: Also trying a quick experiment: in the routing layer we can set per-tenant dynamic_batching.window_ms = 50 for Acme to bias latency over throughput. Want us to try that for the next 30 minutes?

AcmeJane: Please try, we're seeing customer-facing timeouts. We'll also try changing max_batch_size to 16 and report back.

Sam (Support): Logged a support action and created an incident: INC-2026. Oncall Bot attached.

Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026 created by Sam (Support) — "embeddings: tail latency spike for AcmeCorp" — priority P2.

Megan (Infra SRE): I pushed a per-tenant override: dynamic_batching.window_ms=50, dynamic_batching.max_wait_ms=120 for AcmeCorp. Monitor pls.

AcmeJane: After switching client max_batch_size -> 16, 99th dropped to ~320ms on the first 10 minutes. With your override it's ~210ms. Looks promising.

Liz H: Good. The logs show queue time before kernel launch dropped from ~800ms to ~90ms. Here's a snippet from our trace: ```
# before override
queue_ms=812
batch_fill_wait_ms=200
kernel_exec_ms=20
# after override
queue_ms=82
batch_fill_wait_ms=35
kernel_exec_ms=23
```

Sam (Support): Two follow-ups: 1) We'll keep the per-tenant override for 24h and monitor; 2) For a long-term fix we'll correlate request shape (token counts + vector dims) and offer an auto-profile that picks batch size dynamically per workload.

AcmeJane: Thanks team. One more oddity: a couple requests returned 400 dimension mismatch yesterday. Could that be related?

Megan (Infra SRE): 400s usually mean client-sent vectors with mismatched dims or bad header. I checked — those 400s were from a different path where we fell back to a legacy embedding shard that expects 768 dims, while you use 512. We applied a route fix to prevent fallback.

AcmeJane: Great. Any billing implications for retries or fallback? We had a burst of duplicate calls.

Sam (Support): We'll review the affected request IDs and submit credit if retries were triggered by our fallback. Please DM me the IDs if you'd rather not post them here.

Liz H: Action items: (1) keep per-tenant batching override for 24h, (2) infra to revert scheduler tweak or make it opt-in, (3) product to consider latency-first profile for embedding endpoints.

Megan (Infra SRE): Filed infra ticket INFRA-817. Will start a rollback plan if the override isn't sufficient.

AcmeJane: Thanks all, latency is back to acceptable for now. Appreciate the fast responses. :thumbsup:

Sam (Support): Happy to help — will update INC-2026 with notes and close if stable.
